info.title: MY GARB PHASONABLE Backend
info.description: MY GARB foundation and authentication. Register customer/designer accounts, then log in using an HttpOnly session cookie. Auth POSTs require JSON and X-MYGARB-Request: 1. Browser origins must be configured; cross-site fetches are rejected. Cookies use SameSite=Strict, Secure in production, and Path=/api. Sessions default to one hour and logout revokes the current session server-side. Login/register share 10 attempts per 15 minutes/IP. General API limit is 100/minute/IP; health probes are exempt. M3 adds owner profiles, designer portfolios, public discovery and private customer measurements. Every write requires JSON and X-MYGARB-Request: 1. No request/order sharing is implemented.

get.description: Requires nonempty business name, location, specialties and at least one portfolio entry. Public fields are exactly those in DesignerProfile. No email, phone, measurements, account status, hashes or sessions. Stable ID order; offset pagination may shift during concurrent edits. Literal case-insensitive substring name/businessName/specialty search; exact case-insensitive location. Unknown, repeated and nested query parameters are rejected. Query timeout 3 seconds; bounded substring search is intended for MVP scale.
